title.zh: 【Ripple 与 Coinbase 合作以扩展 RLUSD 的获取渠道】
title.en: 【Ripple 与 Coinbase 合作以扩展 RLUSD 的获取渠道】

current_state.zh: Ripple partnered with Coinbase to make RLUSD available to retail and institutional customers across Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange, and the Coinbase app, with 1:1 conversion from USD and supported USD stablecoins and future trading and collateral use.
current_state.en: Ripple partnered with Coinbase to make RLUSD available to retail and institutional customers across Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange, and the Coinbase app, with 1:1 conversion from USD and supported USD stablecoins and future trading and collateral use.
